overview: At the reckoning you wrote the share as one-and-thirty shillings. You wrote that the coffer was not opened, and that it stands as ruled, at twenty pound fifteen shillings. You did not make a new total.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.
